property_summary: When transferAnyERC20Token is called on a tokenAddress that is not a contract (no code), the call must revert unless tokenAddress is the address of c itself (which also has no code from the checker's perspective), in which case it may succeed or revert depending on the balance but cannot underflow; more specifically, if tokenAddress is a plain externally-owned account with no code and is not the zero-address, the call reverts.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `transferAnyERC20Token(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
